messages.author: 4918a340a628dfb6
messages.subject: JGR 1.7.16
parts:
Hi,

I try to install Deducer on Windows but get an error indicating that I need jgr.exe version 1.7.16 or higher. Updating jgr.exe only installs version 1.7.15.

My jgrLaunch.bat file
set R_LIBS=%USERPROFILE%\Documents\R\win-library\3.0
jgr.exe --libpath=%USERPROFILE%\Documents\R\win-library\3.0

Any ideas where to find jgr.exe version 1.7.16 ?

I am somewhat puzzled as I follow the instructions on the Deducer website. Are they up to date ?

A second error comes from that R does not find Java !

library(rJava)
Error : .onLoad a échoué dans loadNamespace() pour 'rJava', détails :
  appel : fun(libname, pkgname)
  erreur : No CurrentVersion entry in Software/JavaSoft registry! Try re-installing Java and make sure R and Java have matching architectures.
What are "matching architectures" and, in particular, how to create them ?

Is there anywhere a step by step guide which guides the user  from a situation where you have nothing installed that is needed for running deducer up to the first page of deducer running?

The idea to simplify R for the end user is excellent but if you have to be an expert user with java etc. to get the simplified version you somewhat limit the usefulness of the entire project. And this is a pity.

TIA

ftr
